content.title: Potash maker Nutrien to sell stake in Argentina's Profertil for $600 million
content.summary: The stake will be acquired jointly by agribusiness companies Adecoagro and Asociacion de Cooperativas Argentinas (ACA) through an 80%-20% partnership, the companies said.  Nutrien said that oil and gas producer YPF, which holds the remaining 50% stake in Profertil, will have 90 days to exercise its right of first refusal.  In March 2024, Reuters reported that Nutrien was mulling the sale of Argentina, Chile and Uruguay assets after steep losses in the region.

content.title: Adecoagro: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: LUXEMBOURG (AP) — Adecoagro SA (AGRO) on Monday reported a second-quarter loss of $17.6 million, after reporting a profit in the same period a year earlier. The Luxembourg-based company said it had a loss of 18 cents per share. Losses, adjusted for non-recurring costs, came to 14 cents per share.
